lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white line segments visible on the primary torso; spacing is approximately equidistant in the mid-region, becoming more condensed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the 6th vertical line (counting from cranial to caudal), located in the upper 25% of the torso height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 3 and 8 exhibit clear discontinuities, terminating in the mid-lateral region before reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 5 distinct white spots is located on the lower haunch above the hock, exhibiting a low-density triangular spatial distribution.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-posterior thigh align along a semi-horizontal geometric axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Juvenile spike morphology; near-linear trajectory with a posterior-dorsal vector at approximately 135 degrees relative to the nasal bridge.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: 1.2:1 ratio of the distance between the apical tips compared to the pixel width of the basal attachment points.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the distal 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white circular spots on the lower mandible region and a high-contrast white transverse chevron located on the bridge of the snout between the orbital regions.
